unit.title: Living Things and Habitats
unit.blurb: Animals and plants live in different habitats that give them what they need. Grouping animals and what they eat.
unit.subject: science

O1.t: Know that a habitat gives a living thing food, water and shelter, and match animals to habitats.

O2.t: Sort animals into groups and know what some animals eat.

lesson.t: A home with everything it needs
p: A **habitat** is the place where a plant or animal lives. A good habitat gives it **food**, **water** and **shelter**.
A camel can go a long time without water, so it can live in the hot, dry **desert**. A polar bear has thick fur to keep warm on the **ice**.
A zoo keeps animals, but their natural habitat is where they live in the wild.

p: **Mammals** have hair or fur and feed their babies milk. **Birds** have feathers and lay eggs. **Fish** have scales and fins and live in water. **Reptiles** have dry, scaly skin.
Some animals eat only **plants**, like rabbits. Some eat **other animals**, like lions. Some eat **both**, like bears.

lesson.t: A whale is not a fish
p: A whale lives in water, but it breathes air and feeds its baby milk, so it is a mammal.
